name: NIST Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
disclaimer: Academic reference and mapping crosswalk inspired by NIST AI 100-1 and NIST AI 600-1 (Generative AI Profile). Not officially endorsed or certified by NIST.

controls.title: Legal and Regulatory Compliance Requirements
controls.description: Legal and regulatory requirements involving AI are understood, managed, and documented by the organization.
controls.verification_guidance: Verify documentation of AI regulatory baseline (e.g., EU AI Act, copyright, privacy laws) and organizational compliance tracking.

controls.title: AI Risk Management Roles and Responsibilities
controls.description: Roles and responsibilities for AI system design, development, deployment, evaluation, and monitoring are established and maintained.
controls.verification_guidance: Examine documented security owner roles, approvals for AI tools, and human review sign-offs.

controls.title: Intended Purpose and Deployment Context
controls.description: Intended purposes, potential positive and negative impacts, context of use, and target user demographics are documented.
controls.verification_guidance: Verify system documentation details target audience, risk profile, and limitations on autonomous action.

controls.title: Third-Party AI and Component Dependencies
controls.description: Risks associated with third-party components, pre-trained foundation models, cloud APIs, and training datasets are identified and managed.
controls.verification_guidance: Check AI Bill of Materials (AIBOM), third-party model SLAs, API token management, and data flow boundary definitions.

controls.title: Adversarial Robustness and Security Testing
controls.description: The AI system is evaluated for adversarial robustness, including prompt injection, data extraction, and evasive inputs.
controls.verification_guidance: Verify presence of automated red-teaming tests, fuzzing, static security analysis, and guardrail validation tests.

controls.title: Privacy and Sensitive Data Protection
controls.description: Data privacy risks and unauthorized sensitive data exposure (PII, credentials) in prompts, outputs, or fine-tuning data are measured.
controls.verification_guidance: Look for automated DLP checks, token masking, and privacy-preserving data retrieval in RAG pipelines.

controls.title: System Output Verification and Fallback Mechanisms
controls.description: Mechanisms to detect unexpected or untrustworthy outputs are in place, with fallback procedures to mitigate harmful consequences.
controls.verification_guidance: Verify output validation, schema enforcement, rate-limits, and circuit breakers when confidence scores fall below threshold.

controls.title: Incident Response and Logging for AI Incidents
controls.description: Procedures for reporting, containing, and remediating AI security and safety incidents are defined and operationalized.
controls.verification_guidance: Examine audit logging for prompts/responses (with secret redaction), anomaly alerts, and incident response runbooks.
